results.description:
Type Nine brings classic T9-style typing to your iPhone with a retro phone keyboard built for fast, private, one-handed texting.
Remember when texting felt simple? Type Nine reimagines the old-school phone keypad for modern iPhone users — combining the familiar 3x4 T9 keyboard layout with smart predictions, swipe gestures, personalization, themes, and privacy-first design.

Whether you miss classic phone texting, want a simpler iPhone keyboard, prefer one-handed typing, or just want something different from the standard touchscreen keyboard, Type Nine gives you a clean, fast, nostalgic way to type.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE TYPE NINE
• Classic T9-style keyboard layout
Type with a familiar phone keypad inspired by the keyboards many of us grew up with.
• Fast one-handed typing
The compact keypad layout makes it easy to text with one hand, whether you are walking, commuting, holding coffee, or multitasking.
• Smart word predictions
Type Nine suggests words as you type, helping you write faster with fewer taps.
• Automatic language detection
Type Nine can suggest words from multiple languages at the same time, so you do not need to constantly switch keyboards while typing.
• Swipe typing with a keypad
Type Nine combines a classic keypad layout with swipe-style movement for a modern typing experience.
• Personal word learning
When you manually type a word that is not in the dictionary, Type Nine can remember it and adapt to the words you use most.
• Private by design
Type Nine does not collect your personal data. Your typing stays yours.
• VoiceOver support
Type Nine was built with accessibility in mind and can be a helpful alternative keyboard for VoiceOver users.
• Custom themes and colors
Personalize your keyboard with different visual styles and make your iPhone feel more like your own.
• Emojis, cursor movement, deletion, and more
Type Nine includes the everyday keyboard tools you expect, rebuilt around a simple keypad experience.

A RETRO KEYBOARD FOR MODERN TEXTING
Type Nine is more than a nostalgia app. It is a practical alternative iPhone keyboard for people who want a faster, simpler, more personal way to text.
Use Type Nine for:
• Text messages
• iMessage
• WhatsApp
• Telegram
• Notes
• Email
• Social apps
• Everyday typing across your iPhone

OLD-SCHOOL FEEL. NEW-SCHOOL EASE.
Type Nine gives you the feeling of classic phone texting with the flexibility of a modern iPhone keyboard.
It is ideal for people who:
• Miss old phone keyboards
• Want a retro keyboard for iPhone
• Prefer T9-style typing
• Like one-handed texting
• Want a simpler keyboard layout
• Care about privacy
• Want a keyboard that feels different
• Use multiple languages
• Want customizable themes
• Prefer a keypad over a full QWERTY layout

TEXT LIKE IT’S FUN AGAIN
Typing on a phone used to feel simple, fast, and satisfying. Type Nine brings that feeling back — with a modern keyboard experience designed for today’s iPhone.

Download Type Nine and bring back the classic T9 keyboard experience.

BASIC IS BACK
